subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's `threadSessions` config name and `parentPeer` addition to the public `plugin-sdk/inbound-envelope` helper, or consolidate on another Google Chat thread-session shape first?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but the new config key and SDK helper parameter become public contracts and overlap with another open Google Chat thread-session PR using different naming.

options.title: Land Refreshed Shape
options.body: Accept this PR's config and SDK direction after conflict resolution, baseline regeneration, and exact-head live Google Chat proof.

options.title: Consolidate Thread Plan
options.body: Pause this PR and choose one implementation/naming with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/68967 before either branch lands.

options.title: Keep SDK Private
options.body: Reject the public inbound-envelope expansion and require the route-parent behavior to stay behind an existing or plugin-local seam.

recommendation.title: Land Refreshed Shape
recommendation.body: Accept this PR's config and SDK direction after conflict resolution, baseline regeneration, and exact-head live Google Chat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across the public SDK helper, routing seams, and Google Chat monitor behavior affected by the decision.
